summary: Full E2E testing of E3C BTP devis/factures/paiements system. All 26 backend tests pass. Complete UI flow tested: admin login, dashboard tabs, client registration, client dashboard, quote listing, invoice listing with payment tranches, Stripe checkout triggered successfully.

issues: Uses browser's native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a custom shadcn calendar component

critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_origins only includes FRONTEND_URL and localhost:3000. If additional preview URLs are used, CORS may block requests.
secure=False on cookies: cookies set with secure=False - acceptable for test/dev but should be True in production.
Quote number collision: next_quote_number() uses count_documents which can produce duplicates if quotes are deleted. Consider using an auto-increment counter instead.
No brute-force protection on /auth/login endpoint (as noted in playbook testing instructions).
seed_data_creation: Test client (test_client_a8449c@example.com), DEV-2026-001 quote (converted), FAC-2026-001 invoice with 2 tranches (Acompte 30%: 325.50€, Solde 70%: 759.50€)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows verified: admin login → /admin with 5 tabs, client registration → /espace-client, quote creation form working, admin can send quotes, client can see quotes (FACTURÉ status shown), client Mes Factures shows payment tranches with Payer buttons, Payer button triggers real Stripe checkout (cs_test_a1rbYoFQHPgV2J9uIyXqmDsPCT0MC...). Backend: all CRUD for quotes/invoices/payments working, PDF generation (reportlab) working for both quotes and invoices. Stripe checkout creation working with sk_test_emergent key via emergentintegrations library. No blocking issues found.
